key_catalyst: Brent crude spiking above $90 on the ninth day of U.S.-Iran strikes and Strait of Hormuz disruption, reigniting inflation and Fed-tightening fears
reasoning: Oil is actively escalating with Brent topping $90 on the ninth consecutive day of U.S.-Iran strikes and Hormuz disruption, an unresolved catalyst that is worsening rather than winding down and directly lifting rate-hike odds (~53% September) against QQQ's long-duration mega-caps. The market did not shrug this off cleanly: QQQ faded to -0.54% as an early semiconductor rebound reversed and investors visibly de-risked ahead of Alphabet/Tesla/Intel, showing the tape is absorbing bad news poorly rather than fully pricing it. With an escalating geopolitical/inflation catalyst plus binary mega-cap earnings looming, overnight gap-down risk into the next open is material.
